ATTENTION_READBACK_MISMATCH: The card did not read back as written.
ATTENTION_READ_FAILED: The attention source could not be read.
ATTENTION_READ_INCOMPLETE: The attention source read did not finish.
ATTENTION_ROW_INVALID: A source row did not match the schema.
ATTENTION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The source database no longer has the properties the card reads.
